---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with an existing workflow, script, or template.
title: "[Bug] "
---

Use the repository's private reporting channel for security issues. Redact sensitive values before sharing diagnostic output.

## Affected component and version

Which workflow, script, or template is affected? Include the ref and runner or stack if relevant.

## Steps to reproduce

Provide the smallest example and the commands or workflow event that triggers it.

## Expected behavior

Describe the result you expected.

## Actual behavior

Include the relevant error or check output.
